'''Infected Flesh''' is a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] used as a [[:Category:Drops#Materials|Material]] to craft a multitude of Items. 

== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Dropped by all [[Assimilated Mobs]]<ref>Except for the [[Assimilated Big Spider]], [[Assimilated Enderman|Enderman]] and [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Ender Dragon]].</ref>
*Dropped by [[Host|Hosts]].
*Dropped by [[Thrall|Thralls]].
*Can be found as loot in [[Benign Growth|Benign Growths]] and [[Malignant Growth|Malignant Growths]].
